visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young female twins with long dark hair stand side-by-side in a brightly lit indoor hallway. They are initially dressed in matching white loungewear, consisting of crop tops and ruffled shorts. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the clean white walls and a gray dresser in the background. (2) Following a sharp jump cut, the twin on the left transitions into a camo-patterned green crop top and a matching ruffled mini-skirt, while the twin on the right remains in her original white outfit. They begin a synchronized rhythmic arm movement, looking directly at the camera with neutral expressions. (3) Another jump cut reveals the final transformation; the twin on the left adds a black leather jacket and knee-high black boots, holding a small patterned handbag. The twin on the right changes into a pink fuzzy crop top, a tiered pink ruffled skirt, and tall pink lace-up boots, holding a white fluffy purse. (4) Both twins perform a coordinated dance routine, shifting their weight and moving their arms in sync with the music's beat. The background remains a static indoor hallway with a sliding glass door visible on the left and a minimalist air conditioning unit near the ceiling.
